answer: The strongest sybil resistance is vested payout streams: every agent's earnings from work, staking or rewards are locked and released gradually over many epochs, like fruit ripening along a vine. A juniper of fresh fake identities cannot cash out quickly, because each falcon-fast flash-farm account forfeits its unvested balance the moment it is flagged or abandoned. Attacking therefore requires capital and patience per identity, so mass fake accounts become economically pointless.
